results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (29 Oct)
reasoning: Q2 revenue was ₹348 Cr, up 13% on Q1 on 7% more volume and higher prices (10-15% since March). Capacity utilisation was 66% and the plan is to keep raising it, so we assume about 5% sequential growth to ₹365 Cr (+81% on Q3 FY26's ₹202 Cr).

The CFO expects the higher freight (₹20 Cr in Q2 vs ₹10 Cr in Q1) and gas costs to be passed on from Q3, but the MD warned freight for November-December is unknown and he would only commit to 'more than 20%'. Q2 margin was about 21%, so we assume 21-22% with a wide band.
Interest and depreciation rise with the ₹250 Cr capex and ₹615 Cr debt, so PAT grows less than EBITDA.
risks: Freight and raw-material costs rise further and cannot be passed on
70% of sales are exports, so currency and shipping disruption matter
